mathematical_obligations.spin_null: L*B=0 and H*B=0 from scalar triple-product cancellation
mathematical_obligations.uncompressed_completeness: For N with rows n_i^T and V with tangent velocities, full uncompressed K=V*N^T+N*V^T has only common-rotation kernel when rank(N)=3. From (I-P)K N=(I-P)V(N^T N)=0 obtain V=N A; then A+A^T=0.
mathematical_obligations.scope_limit: Uncompressed completeness is NOT completeness of compressed bins
mathematical_obligations.covariance: H*Sigma*H^T exact; C0 block independence is a separate unqualified working assumption
mathematical_obligations.duplicate_pair_invariance: Duplicating all pairs within bin changes no mean operator/statistic
mathematical_obligations.physical_interpretation: No physical boost/global-shear identification from this finite observed response
